question: Why do mutations in DNA polymerase proofreading lead to cancer?
answer: Mutations in DNA polymerase proofreading can lead to cancer because they prevent the correction of errors during DNA replication. These uncorrected errors can accumulate and lead to mutations that drive cancer development.
